class.name: IfcPlateStandardCase
class.brief_description: The standard plate, IfcPlateStandardCase , defines a plate with certain constraints for the provision of material usage, parameters and with certain constraints for the geometric representation. The IfcPlateStandardCase handles all cases of plates, that: have a reference to the IfcMaterialLayerSetUsage defining the material layers of the plate with thicknesses are based on an extrusion of a planar
